summary_en: ¥10,000M upper limit, 4,500,000 shares (2.94% of shares outstanding), open-market purchase, Aug 10 2026–Mar 31 2027. Concurrent cancellation of 4,500,000 shares (2.79% of pre-cancellation issued total) planned for Aug 24 2026.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Pertaining to Treasury Stock Acquisition and Treasury Stock Cancellation
translation_en_brief:
On August 7, 2026, the board of SANKI ENGINEERING resolved to acquire up to 4,500,000 treasury shares (2.94% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥10,000 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period August 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The board also resolved to cancel those same 4,500,000 shares on August 24, 2026, reducing issued shares outstanding from 161,983,468 to 156,483,468.

The acquisition is part of the firm's Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 capital strategy, which targets stable and sustainable dividends at a pure-asset dividend yield (DOE) of 5.0% or higher, coupled with opportunistic acquisition of approximately 12 million shares over three years. The current fiscal year targets 4.5 million shares. Treasury shares acquired will support restricted-stock awards to executives and future M&A activity; shares beyond a 5% holding policy target will be cancelled as standard practice.
